recap: Donovan Mitchell led the Cavaliers with 26 points (8-17 FG, 4-11 3PT), 7 rebounds and 5 assists.
Bam Adebayo led the Heat with 34 points (11-18 FG, 3-5 3PT), 12 rebounds and 5 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, ball security, second chances. Effective FG% 55.2 to 51.2.
Biggest swing: Max Strus defensive rebound (Q4 1:38), +17 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Mitchell, Strus, Hunter, Garland, Mobley, +7 in 4:36.
Bench points: CLE 40, MIA 37. Points in the paint: 54–40. Second-chance points: 15–12.
